newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish August trade surplus FIM 3.47 billion -NCB.
newsitem.headline: Finnish August trade surplus FIM 3.47 billion -NCB.

text.p: Finland's trade surplus rose to 3.47 billion markka in August from 3.17 billion in July, the National Customs Board (NCB) said in a statement on Friday.
The value of exports rose two percent year-on-year in August while the value of imports fell one percent, NCB said.
The Bank of Finland earlier estimated the August trade surplus at 3.5 billion markka with exports estimated at 13.8 billion and imports at 10.3 billion.
The NCB's official monthly trade statistics are lagging behind due to changes in customs procedures when Finland joined the European Union at the start of 1995. @
